name: Topaz Photo AI
tagline: Topaz Photo AI combines Topaz's best AI models — Sharpen AI, Denoise AI, and Gigapixel AI — into one intelligent workflow. It automatically detects and corrects blur, noise, and low resolution in a single pass. Photographers and studios use it to recover technically imperfect shots and upscale images for large-format printing.
